IC.IC1: Subjects must be capable of providing signed and dated written informed consent by date of Visit 0 (-2 week).
IC.IC3: Subjects diagnosed of schizophrenia as defined by Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, 4th edition text revision or 5th edition (DSM-<U+2163>-TR or 5) criteria, and a history of illness for at least for 3 years prior to screening.
IC.IC4: Subjects who take atypical antipsychotic drugs, and should be maintained on current antipsychotic drugs (including atypical antipsychotic drugs) and dose for at least 4 weeks prior to the screening.
IC.IC5: Subjects who need antipsychotic treatment (other than clozapine), and would be stable when switching to long-acting injectable aripiprazole in the investigator's judgement.
IC.IC6: Subjects must exhibit willingness, physiologic capability, and an educational level sufficient to comply with all protocol procedures.
